14.12.2023 Heard Mr. P. Daimary, learned counsel for the petitioner and also heard Mr. R.R.
Kaushik, learned Additional Public Prosecutor, Assam, appearing for the State respondent.

This is an application under Section 438 of the Cr.P.C. praying for grant of pre- arrest bail to the petitioner, namely, Subhankar Upadhaya, who has been apprehending arrest in connection with Dwarbond P.S. Case No.69/2021 under Section 498A with added Page No.# 2/2 Section 417/493/376 of the Indian Penal Code.

sentences.text: The informant lady has raised that she was in love with the petitioner and they married in a temple.
It is alleged that after sometime, the petitioner started to avoid her.
Thereafter, on one occasion they had a quarrel wherein she was allegedly beaten up by the petitioner.
On a plain reading of the FIR it appears that for consideration of the pre-arrest bail prayer of the petitioner, case diary is not required.
I have considered the submissions made by the learned counsel of both sides.
It is a settled position of law that a simple promise to marry anyone or anything more, does not amount to misconception of fact, as provided under Section 91 of the Indian Penal Code.
Accordingly, this Court is of the opinion that the petitioner, namely, Subhankar Upadhaya does not deserve to be detained in custody.
His anticipatory bail application is allowed.

It is hereby directed that in the event of arrest of the petitioner, namely, Subhankar Upadhaya, in connection with Dwarbond P.S. Case No.69/2021 under Section 498A with added Section 417/493/376 of the Indian Penal Code, he shall be enlarged on pre-arrest bail on furnishing a bond of ` 25,000/- with one surety of like amount to the satisfaction of the arresting authority.
The anticipatory bail application stands disposed of accordingly.
